description: Profile v1 conformance: definition acceptance/rejection and structural evaluation cases. This index is separate from the base Umpire conformance index.

fixtures.description: Avenor-shaped workflow: arrays of node objects, nested strict objects, tagged union actions (manual/run/loop), local $defs references, enums, constants, and coexisting Umpire validators.

failures.description: Profile definition rejection: excluded JSON Schema keywords, mismatched fields, incompatible isEmpty, invalid defaults, invalid references, invalid discriminators, colliding names, and unsafe numbers.
